main.subtitle: Weblings Team Chat
main.title:
Enterprise-grade client calls that turn into actionable tickets.
Zero premium price tag.
main.content: Enjoy global video conferencing and unlimited chats, fully included in your suite. Say goodbye to miscommunication: our built-in AI translates client conversations straight into assignable tasks and flags scope changes instantly. Turn every call into a guaranteed plan of action.

features.subtitle: Internet-Scale Infrastructure
features.title: Built on the Backbone of the Modern Internet.
content: A chat app is useless if it drops connections. We engineered our communications architecture on a sprawling global edge network to deliver flawless, uninterrupted reliability.

• Ultra-Low Latency Edge Routing: Your chats and video calls are automatically routed through the closest data center to your employees, guaranteeing ultra-low latency whether they are in Chennai or Chicago.
• Simulcast Video Scaling: Host calls with hundreds of participants without crashing laptops with dynamic real-time video quality adjustment.
• Zero-Setup Project Channels: As soon as a project is created in the management portal, respective teams automatically get a dedicated chat group with instant file access.

features.subtitle: Built-In AI Intelligence
features.title: Stop the "Telephone Game." Protect Your Margins.
content: • From Conversation to Code: When project details pass from clients to managers to developers, critical context is often lost. We eliminate this friction. Our AI captures the client's exact requirements during the call and generates accurate, assignable tickets directly for your development team.

• Smart Search & Instant Proof: Say goodbye to the 'he said, she said' blame game. Our AI creates an instantly searchable memory of every meeting. If a client argues they asked for a 'PDF' instead of an 'Excel' file on Tuesday, just ask the AI. It instantly provides the exact answer, quoting the date, time, and client's exact words.

features.subtitle: Mobile Apps
features.title: Your Team, In Your Pocket.
content: Available on both iOS and Android. Take live 4K video calls, review AI meeting extracts, and manage your team from anywhere. Business doesn't stop when you step away from your desk.

usage.subtitle: Enterprise Usage
usage.title: Enterprise Features, No Extra Invoice
usage.description: Unlike other platforms, you never pay extra for group video calls, unlimited message history, or screen recording. File retention is dictated by your organization's needs, not an arbitrary 6-month lockwall. It is 100% included in your flat Weblings Worksuite invoice.

cards.title: Picture-in-Picture
cards.description: Keep the video floating while you browse other modules and tickets.

cards.title: Screen Recording
cards.description: Native screen sharing and recording saved directly to your cloud Drive buckets.

cards.title: Complete Privacy Between Branches
cards.description: Regional teams get entirely private workspaces, ensuring sensitive local data never leaks.

cards.title: Custom Retention
cards.description: Files and message history are preserved based on your strict organization rules.
